heading: Loved by Students & Organizers Across India
subheading: See what community members, festival leads, and campus ambassadors have to say about CrwdCtrl.

reviews.name: Aman Singh
reviews.quote: CrwdCtrl made it effortlessly simple to discover college events near me. I've participated in 3 hackathons already, and the registration process was completely seamless!

reviews.name: Priya Sharma
reviews.quote: The location-based fest & club discovery is an absolute game changer. Found an active weekend running club and registered in under 30 seconds!

reviews.name: Rohit Verma
reviews.quote: We listed our cultural fest on CrwdCtrl and saw a 50% jump in outstation registrations. The live check-in scanner and attendee export tools saved us hours.

reviews.name: Sneha Kapoor
reviews.quote: The clean dark mode UI and detailed fest breakdown (rules, prize pool, schedule) make this the only platform college students need.

reviews.name: Ankit Patel
reviews.quote: Hosting our youth camping treks through CrwdCtrl brought hundreds of passionate college students to our trails. Transparent, fast, and reliable.

reviews.name: Riya Sen
reviews.quote: Managing artist announcements, competition registrations, and gate check-ins was so stress-free. Highly recommend every college fest committee to use CrwdCtrl!
